notes: GeoTalk 1: Fixes the app closing during internet calls — if the voice engine cannot start on a phone, the call now falls back to Push-to-Talk instead of the app closing. NEW: in-app problem report — if anything goes wrong, the app saves a report of what happened; on the next launch it shows the report with a Copy button, and it is always available under Profile → Problem report, so you can copy it and share it to get the real problem fixed fast. From now on GeoTalk versions use a simple series: 1, 1.1, 1.2 and so on. Everything else is kept: near-instant call ringing and setup, direct phone-to-phone WebRTC voice first, Cloudflare TURN relay (UDP, TCP and TLS 443) when a network blocks the direct path, Push-to-Talk as the final fallback, plus internet and Bluetooth chat + voice calls, voice messages and in-app updates.
